MANDARIN — TERMLY EXAM #11
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Interactive Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Interactive Speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Interactive Speaking.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Interactive Speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Interactive Speaking.

2. When practising Reading for Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Fluency.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Fluency.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Fluency.

3. When practising Listening for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information.

4. In MANDARIN, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Only memorise without using the language
   C. Mix random languages with no purpose
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

5. When practising Active Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Active Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Active Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Active Listening.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Active Listening.

6. When practising Oral Expression, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Oral Expression.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Oral Expression.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Oral Expression.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Oral Expression.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
